classes.class: A income credited on the emptied day
classes.mechanism: Reused from round 64 class A. The account holds a leftover cash balance (prior value under 1.00); on the day a dividend is credited and the leftover plus the credit is withdrawn, so value is 0 and the day return is outflow / prior value - 1, which is the income / prior value (1.00). The income stays inside the return (a dividend is internal) and the withdrawal is an end-of-day flow. Hand-checked 3 of 3.
classes.line: flows:59 (dv), :37 (lo is a flow); returns:271 (end timing)

classes.class: A2 income credited to a leftover balance
classes.mechanism: New. Same mechanism as A but the account is not emptied that day: an earlier close-out left a cash balance (outflows in the prior 20 rows were 10 or more times the prior value on 103 of 105; the prior day is cash only on 103 of 105), then a dividend, interest or reinvested distribution (net of a foreign or federal tax row on 9) is credited, so value rises. The return is the day's net income / prior value (reproduced to 0.01 on 105 of 105). Income is internal so it is in the return; the base is what the close-out left. Of the 102 days with income rows on a security, 101 have every such row on a security the account did not hold the day before. Hand-checked 17 of 105.

classes.class: E fee rebate credited to a leftover balance
classes.mechanism: New. A management-fee row (man) with a positive Amount and Quantity (the custodian's rebate or credit; 94 of 97 have note text beginning Fee Rebate, 89 of 97 are dated 2026-05-22 or 2026-06-09) credits the account's cash. man is a drag inside the return, not a flow, so the credit raises the return: day return = rebate (plus any income) / prior value, reproduced to 0.01 on 97 of 97. The base is a cash-only leftover on 61 of 97 and a close-out left it (outflows in the prior 20 rows 10 or more times the prior value) on 95 of 97. Hand-checked 9 of 97.
classes.line: flows:86 (man fee, internal), :121 (man is a drag under the method); signs:75 (man quantity carries its own sign); returns:271

classes.class: F fee owed elsewhere charged to a leftover balance
classes.mechanism: New. A ManAltT row (a management fee owed by this account and paid from another) is not debited from this account's cash, so the day's numerator takes its Amount (adj): return = (value - flow + adj) / prior value - 1, a large negative number on a prior value under 1.00 while value and flow do not move (value / prior value 1.00). Arithmetic as the method states; the base is a leftover (withdrawals before the day are 1.4 million times it; the prior 20 rows carry none). The only negative day of the 207. Hand-checked 1 of 1.

classes.class: G in-kind contribution valued from a close the sale contradicts
classes.mechanism: New. The account opens with an in-kind contribution (li, Amount 0) of one security; the form values the shares at the price store's close (flow 1.00 of prior value) and the next day the account sells the whole quantity for 6.72 times that value, so the day return is 5.72. The delivered sale price is 6.72 times the close the form used. The cause of the close is not established (see not_established). First measured day of the account. Hand-checked 1 of 1.
classes.line: returns:150-152 (zero-Amount in-kind valued at quantity x price), :271

evidence.finding: set rebuilt as the face defines it: measured rows (non-null return) of daily_returns.parquet whose prior value (same account, previous row by date) is positive
evidence.count: 107,311 measured rows with a positive prior value; 207 with abs(return) > 1; 55 on a prior value under 1.00, 152 on 1.00 or more (95 from 1.00 to under 100.00, 57 of 100.00 or more); the 207 sit on 170 accounts
evidence.denominator: 107,316 measured rows; 107,311 with a positive prior

evidence.finding: identity: return = (value - flow) / prior - 1 on every row. For each of the 207 the return is compared with the sum, over the day's rows (effective trading day), of income rows (dv, dvlt, dvst, int, roy, 12b1, ileu, ac, DVX, INTX), man Amounts and ftax/stax/frntax Amounts, each divided by the prior value

A 3, A2 105, E 97, F 1, G 1 = 207; unexplained 0

evidence.finding: G: sale proceeds against the form's close

evidence.finding: threshold table over all measured rows: count with abs(return) strictly above each level, by prior value band
evidence.count: see threshold_table; the 1.00 row is 55 + 95 + 57 = 207; each column is non-increasing down the table; band totals of the 107,311 measured rows: 5,437 under 1.00, 6,471 from 1.00 to under 100.00, 95,403 of 100.00 or more

evidence.finding: hand checks: each sampled day printed from the transactions of the day and 2 rows either side, the holdings of the day and the prior day, and the flow, value and return ratios
evidence.count: A 3 of 3; A2 17 of 105 (7 under 1.00, 8 from 1.00 to under 100.00, 2 of 100.00 or more); E 9 of 97 (2 under 1.00, 4 from 1.00 to under 100.00, 3 of 100.00 or more); F 1 of 1; G 1 of 1. 31 of 207 in all

not_established: No custodian day return was read, so none of the 207 is compared with what the custodian reported; the classes say which credit row carries each day's return, not whether the custodian reports it.

RESIDUAL_BASE is assigned where the prior value is what a close-out left (test E5). Whether a leftover of 100.00 or more (A2 35 days, E 21) is too small for a return on it to mean anything is the CTO's threshold; the record gives the band counts and does not rule it.

Class E: that the Fee Rebate Amount is money the client received is read from the custodian's note text and the cash line rising by the Amount; why a fee is credited to accounts already closed out is not established.

Class A2: the income rows are credited after the shares left (101 of 102 days with income on a security have every row on a security not held the day before). Whether that is the record-date rule paying the account or a dating difference in the custodian's rows is not established.
Class F rests on one day; the method rule (ManAltT taken at its Amount as a drag, flows:127) is applied as written and not tested against the custodian.

Class G: why the price-store close is 6.72 times lower than the sale price is not established (price scale, another instrument's series, or a stale series); the sale price is the delivered Amount over Quantity and is not checked against a market price. Kind FORM rests on the form's value of the shares and the delivered proceeds disagreeing on a day with no other cause.
Classes A2 and E were hand-checked on 17 of 105 and 9 of 97 days; the remainder rest on the identity (E2) and the row-type evidence (E4 to E9), not on a printed day.
Two E days carry a ManAltF row taken as a flow beside a man credit taken as a drag (E9); whether that is a defect of the form is not ruled here.
